protocol.name: Mintlayer
protocol.summary: Mintlayer is a Bitcoin-native sidechain providing smart contracts, asset tokenization, and DeFi execution anchored to Bitcoin’s security model without adding UTXO bloat.
protocol.constraints: Wnode remains stateless and non-custodial. All Mintlayer interactions must be ephemeral, signed in-memory, executed, and cleared without retention. No private keys, logs, or cryptographic state persist after execution.

integration.type: Stateless RPC and WebSocket protocol mapping for Mintlayer’s UTXO-based execution environment, including atomic swaps and contract calls.
data_flows: Agents dispatch raw unsigned Mintlayer transaction payloads into ephemeral memory for contract execution.
Settlement flows route through Mintlayer’s tokenization and liquidity layer using HTLC-based atomic swap logic.
All transaction metadata is processed in RAM and wiped immediately after block-finality confirmation.
security: Ephemeral signing keys generated per execution cycle.
No custody or persistent state; Wnode acts only as a transient compute substrate.
Encrypted in-memory processing with immediate memory wipe on settlement confirmation.

value_to_wnode.bitcoin_anchor: Extends Wnode’s agent workflows directly into Bitcoin’s liquidity base and collateral structures.
value_to_wnode.defi_expansion: Adds Bitcoin-native DeFi, token issuance, and programmable financial primitives to the agent capability set.
value_to_wnode.scalability: Provides a high-throughput execution layer aligned with Wnode’s sovereign compute model, bypassing Bitcoin’s scripting limits.

value_to_mintlayer.volume: Generates continuous machine-driven execution volume and block-space demand.
value_to_mintlayer.distribution: Expands Mintlayer’s reach into autonomous agent networks and automated liquidity routing.
value_to_mintlayer.positioning: Positions Mintlayer as a core Bitcoin-native settlement and DeFi rail inside sovereign compute ecosystems.

workflow_examples: An agent constructs and signs a Mintlayer atomic swap transaction, submits it, verifies block confirmation, and wipes its session state.
Agents rebalance Mintlayer liquidity pools based on market data, executing swaps and contract calls without storing user data.
A compute agent issues an MLS-01 token, settles liquidity, and clears all intermediate memory after execution.

drivers: Token issuance and asset tokenization flows
Cross-chain atomic swaps and liquidity routing
Continuous agent-driven execution and automation fees
